title: Brazil installer meeting
zhtitle: 巴西幕墙安装商采购洽谈
intro: 与巴西幕墙安装公司的首次采购洽谈：海边涂层、防火芯材、报价、起订量和后续安排。
note: 根据会议转写整理，措辞有润色；报价、起订量和公司名已隐去。音频为 AI 合成语音。

lines.en: For projects close to the [[coastline]], we need to apply a special PVDF [[coating]] made for coastal areas.
lines.zh: 靠近海岸线的项目，我们需要用海边专用的 PVDF 涂层。

lines.en: The normal coating should be used in places at least two to five kilometers away from the coast.
lines.zh: 普通涂层应该用在离海岸至少两到五公里的地方。

lines.en: We use PVDF coating from a global US supplier, which is designed for environments with a high [[salt]] content.
lines.zh: 我们用的是一家美国全球涂料供应商的 PVDF 涂层，专为高盐环境设计。

lines.en: Actually, fire resistance is not a [[regulation]] here yet. But we have some customers that ask for [[fire-resistant]] material.
lines.zh: 其实这里防火还不是强制规定，但有些客户会要求防火材料。

lines.en: So we have both situations. Do you have this material available in your factory, or is it just more expensive?
lines.zh: 所以两种情况都有。你们工厂有这种材料吗，还是只是更贵？

lines.en: Okay, just to make sure I understood correctly: you're asking if we have FR material available, right?
lines.zh: 好的，确认一下我理解得对：您是问我们有没有 FR 防火材料，对吗？

lines.en: Yes, right. I just want to confirm: is there a [[fire-retardant]] option?
lines.zh: 对。我只是想确认：有没有阻燃的选项？

lines.en: Yes, we have a fire-retardant option available when needed.
lines.zh: 有的，需要的时候我们可以提供阻燃选项。

lines.en: We understand that the final price will be affected by the [[shipping]] and also the [[customs]] taxes.
lines.zh: 我们理解最终价格会受到运费和关税的影响。

lines.en: But I would like to have some [[reference prices]] for the material with this exact [[specification]].
lines.zh: 但我想先要一些这个具体规格的参考价格。

lines.en: One second, please. Four millimeter, zero point five, PVDF, LDPE [[core]].
lines.zh: 请稍等。四毫米，零点五，PVDF，LDPE 芯材。

lines.en: So the reference price is for four millimeter, with an [[aluminum skin]] thickness of zero point five millimeter?
lines.zh: 所以参考价是四毫米、铝皮厚度零点五毫米的？

lines.en: Yes. I'll send you the price range in writing after the meeting. This is an [[FOB]] price.
lines.zh: 是的。会后我把价格区间书面发给您。这是 FOB 价。

lines.en: Okay, just one more thing. Regarding the minimum volume, do you have a minimum [[quantity]] per shipment?
lines.zh: 好的，还有一件事。关于最小量，每次发货有最低数量吗？

lines.en: Yes, we have a standard [[MOQ]] per color. But for some projects, customers only need a smaller quantity.
lines.zh: 有，我们每个颜色有标准起订量。但有些项目客户只需要更少的量。

lines.en: Sometimes another customer orders the same color, so we can [[combine]] your order with theirs, and you don't need to pay extra.
lines.zh: 有时别的客户订了同一个颜色，我们可以把您的订单和他们的拼在一起，您就不用额外付费。

lines.en: Otherwise, if the order is below the minimum per color, you need to pay a little [[extra]].
lines.zh: 否则，如果每个颜色的量低于起订量，就需要多付一点。

lines.en: Okay, so the price for the coastal option is a little higher. That's clear.
lines.zh: 好的，所以海边那个选项的价格高一点。明白了。

lines.en: My colleague is asking: does anyone on your team plan to send a [[representative]] to Brazil to visit customers this year?
lines.zh: 我同事想问：你们团队今年有没有计划派代表来巴西拜访客户？

lines.en: This will be our first contact with a Chinese supplier. We want to build a good [[relationship]] and show you how we operate here in Brazil.
lines.zh: 这是我们第一次接触中国供应商。我们想建立良好的关系，让你们了解我们在巴西怎么运作。

lines.en: Our business is not selling ACP panels. Our business is [[installing]] ACP on buildings.
lines.zh: 我们的业务不是卖铝塑板，而是在建筑上安装铝塑板。

lines.en: Actually, we don't have this plan right now. But if necessary, we can [[arrange]] it.
lines.zh: 其实我们现在没有这个计划，但如果需要，可以安排。

lines.en: We have two groups of customers. One is [[importers]], who buy from us and sell to local companies.
lines.zh: 我们有两类客户。一类是进口商，从我们这里买货再卖给当地公司。

lines.en: The second group is [[installers]], like your company. Half of our customers are installers.
lines.zh: 第二类是像贵公司这样的安装商。我们一半的客户是安装商。

lines.en: That's great. I think we'll need some time to [[evaluate]] the numbers and the conditions, and then we can set up a second meeting.
lines.zh: 很好。我想我们需要些时间评估数字和条件，然后再约第二次会议。

lines.en: No problem. Tomorrow I will check the [[freight forwarder]] cost and the [[customs broker]] for you.
lines.zh: 没问题。明天我帮您查货代费用和清关代理。

lines.en: We'll put it all together and give you a [[delivered price]] to your factory. Then you can compare it with your local purchase price.
lines.zh: 我们会汇总起来，给您一个到厂价，您可以和本地采购价比较。

lines.en: Since you're an installer, do you work on small projects or medium to large projects?
lines.zh: 既然您是安装商，你们做的是小项目还是中大型项目？

lines.en: Actually, we have a [[mix]] of large and small projects. The minimum area we work with is three hundred square meters.
lines.zh: 其实大小项目都有。我们做的最小面积是三百平方米。

lines.en: At the beginning of October, we're going to start a building with six thousand square meters of ACP and two thousand square meters of [[WPC]].
lines.zh: 十月初我们要开工一栋楼，有六千平方米铝塑板和两千平方米木塑板。

lines.en: That's eight thousand square meters for just one building. Our [[objective]] is to have international suppliers for the larger projects.
lines.zh: 单这一栋就八千平方米。我们的目标是大项目用国际供应商。

lines.en: From your screen sharing, I think buying from an international supplier makes sense for you, because it will be [[cost-effective]] for your projects.
lines.zh: 从您的屏幕共享看，我觉得从国际供应商采购适合你们，因为对你们的项目更划算。

lines.en: For small projects with regular colors, you could keep [[stock]] of five or six regular colors, one or two [[containers]], for long-term use.
lines.zh: 对常规颜色的小项目，你们可以备五六个常规色的库存，一两个柜，长期使用。

lines.en: Okay, that's something we need to plan, but I think it will be interesting for us.
lines.zh: 好的，这需要我们规划一下，但我觉得对我们挺有意思的。

lines.en: Okay, very well. Thank you so much. Do you have any other questions?
lines.zh: 好的，非常好。非常感谢。您还有别的问题吗？

lines.en: No, that's all for now. I hope to talk to you again soon.
lines.zh: 没有了，暂时就这些。希望很快再聊。

lines.en: Me too. Okay, bye bye!
lines.zh: 我也是。好的，再见！

quiz.q: How far from the coast should the normal coating be used?
options: At least two to five kilometers
quiz.explain: 普通涂层要离海岸至少两到五公里，更近的要用海边专用 PVDF。

quiz.q: Is fire resistance required by regulation in Brazil?
options: Not yet, but some customers ask for it
quiz.explain: 目前还不是强制规定，但部分客户会要求。

quiz.q: What specification does Susan quote for?
options: 4 mm, 0.5 mm skin, PVDF, LDPE core
quiz.explain: 四毫米，铝皮 0.5 毫米，PVDF 涂层，LDPE 芯材。

quiz.q: What price term is the reference price?
quiz.explain: 参考价是 FOB，不含海运、清关和关税。

quiz.q: How can a small order avoid the extra charge?
options: By combining it with another customer's order in the same color
By picking it up from the factory
quiz.explain: 可以和同色的其他客户订单拼在一起生产。

quiz.q: What is the Brazilian company's main business?
quiz.explain: 他们的业务是在建筑上安装铝塑板，而不是卖板。

quiz.q: How large is the building project starting in early October?
quiz.explain: 六千平方米铝塑板加两千平方米木塑板，共八千平方米。

options: Check freight and customs broker costs to give a delivered price
quiz.explain: 查货代和清关代理费用，给出到厂价，方便客户和本地采购价比较。
